paper_title: Superradiance Exclusions in the Landscape of Type IIB String Theory
suggested_experiment_name: Black hole superradiance (NGC 7469 SMBH + GRO J1655-40 stellar BH), type IIB string landscape
coupling_convention: f_pert (perturbative axion decay constant, f_pert^2 = m^2/lambda_iiii) in GeV as plotted on the y-axis; x-axis is axion mass m_a in eV. Values emitted exactly as plotted (f_a-m_a plane).
notes: This paper uses black hole superradiance (BHSR) to statistically exclude fractions of Calabi-Yau compactifications in the type IIB string landscape, based on axion masses and self-interaction decay constants (m_a, f_pert). While the analysis operates in the (m_a, f_pert) plane (roughly f_a vs m_a, hence AxionMass), the main result (Fig. 3) is a fraction of excluded manifolds vs Hodge number h^1,1, not a new exclusion contour on any coupling-mass plane. The BHSR exclusion regions used (Fig. 2, e.g. GRO J1655-40 covering ~1e-13 to 1e-10 eV, NGC 7469 covering ~1e-20 to 1e-17 eV) are adopted from prior work (Stott & Marsh 2018, Stott 2020) rather than newly derived here.
